notes: This file no longer holds naming data. It is kept so policy_revision can still say which naming contract a roster was built against - revision 1 is interim parent-race tables, revision 2 is the heritage genome - which a consumer reading an older export needs in order to tell them apart. Do not add tables here; extend the genome.

supersede.note: Superseded on 2026-09-19. Names now come from the heritage genome keyed by civilization id. The interim parent-race tables are removed: they gave nine of the twelve cultures their parent’s names and gave tidekin, gnome, hill_dwarf and frosthold_dwarf human ones outright.
